# Acta Scientific

> > Acta Scientific is an international open-access academic publishing platform offering peer-reviewed journals across medicine, science, and specialized disciplines with rigorous double-blind peer review processes.

Acta Scientific operates as part of the International Open Library and Journals Publishing Group, publishing high-quality peer-reviewed open-access research across multiple medical and scientific specialties. The platform features journals in urology, anaesthesiology, pharmacology, microbiology, nutrition, orthopedics, and other fields, with a commitment to transparent peer review and global research dissemination.

## Key Topics

- Open-Access Publishing
- Peer-Review Process
- Double-Blind Peer Review

## Core Medical Journals

- [Acta Scientific Urology (ASUR)](https://actascientific.com/ASUR.php): Open-access peer-reviewed journal publishing urology research and clinical studies
- [Acta Scientific Anaesthesiology (ASAN)](https://actascientific.com/ASAN.php): Open-access medical journal dedicated to anaesthesiology research and practice
- [Acta Scientific Pharmacology (ASPC)](https://actascientific.com/ASPC.php): Open-access peer-reviewed journal publishing pharmacology and drug research
- [Acta Scientific Microbiology (ASMI)](https://actascientific.com/ASMI.php): Peer-reviewed open-access journal covering microbiology research and infectious diseases

## Featured Research Articles

- [SARS-CoV-2 Molecular Docking and Viral Entry](https://actascientific.com/ASMI/ASMI-06-1263.php): Research article on SARS-CoV-2 molecular docking and viral entry mechanisms
- [Cancer Imaging Using Contrast-Enhanced Ultrasonography](https://actascientific.com/ASCB/ASCB-07-0422.php): Cancer imaging research using contrast-enhanced ultrasonography techniques
- [Carotenoids and Nutritional Bioavailability](https://actascientific.com/ASNH/ASNH-07-1258.php): Nutritional health case report on carotenoids and bioavailability in diet
- [Retinopathy of Prematurity Screening in Tunisia](https://actascientific.com/ASPE/ASPE-06-0592.php): Pediatric research on retinopathy of prematurity screening protocols and outcomes
- [Pediatric Tibial Spine Fracture Management](https://actascientific.com/ASOR/ASOR-06-0769.php): Pediatric orthopedic case report on tibial spine fracture management techniques
- [Pancreatic Cancer Histology and Pathology](https://actascientific.com/ASGIS/ASGIS-06-0536.php): Gastrointestinal pathology research on pancreatic cancer histological analysis
- [Mustard Disease Management and Crop Yield](https://actascientific.com/ASAG/ASAG-07-1268.php): Agricultural research on mustard disease management and crop yield optimization
